item.title: AI Briefing — Tuesday, May 5, 2026
item.description: The White House is considering an executive order that would give the federal government a formal role in vetting all new AI models before market release, briefing executives from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI on early plans. A working group of tech executives and U.S. officials would design the oversight process, with options including formal government review. The Pentagon finalized AI agreements with OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, Nvidia, SpaceX, and Reflection AI to expand AI use into classified environments for analysis, logistics, and large-scale data processing. Anthropic was excluded after being labeled a supply-chain risk following a contract dispute, a designation it is contesting in court.

item.title: AI Briefing — Monday, May 4, 2026
item.description: Anthropic announced today (May 4, 2026) the formation of a new enterprise AI services company in partnership with Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs. The move signals deepening Wall Street and private equity involvement in deploying frontier AI models for large enterprise customers. The Department of Defense announced agreements with AWS, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA, OpenAI, SpaceX, Oracle, and Reflection to deploy AI on classified networks, deliberately excluding Anthropic after its refusal to allow Claude for autonomous weapons and mass surveillance use. The deal reshapes the U.S. government AI supply chain and intensifies the political fight over AI safety guardrails.

item.title: AI Briefing — Friday, May 1, 2026
item.description: The Defense Department announced Friday it reached agreements with SpaceX, OpenAI, Google, NVIDIA, Reflection, Microsoft and AWS to deploy AI on classified networks (Impact Levels 6 and 7). Anthropic was notably excluded as the Pentagon continues to label it a supply-chain risk, though officials hinted at reconsideration. OpenAI began rolling out GPT-5.5 to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users in ChatGPT and Codex, with GPT-5.5 Pro available to higher tiers. The model offers a 400K context window in Codex and a Fast mode generating tokens 1.5x faster, with API availability coming soon.
